55 Gujarat Towns to Get GIS-Based Development Plans Under AMRUT 2.0

📅 2026-07-27 ✍️ DeshGujarat 🏷️ Gujarat, GIS, master plans, AMRUT 2.0, drone surveys, Survey of India, urban planning, India
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

The Gujarat government has launched a ₹40 crore project to prepare GIS-based development plans for 55 towns with populations between 50,000 and 100,000, using drone surveys and Survey of India geo-databases under the Centre's AMRUT 2.0 mission.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The Gujarat government is preparing GIS-based development plans (master plans) for 55 towns with populations between 50,000 and one lakh (100,000)
  • The project is estimated at ₹40 crore, with the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs providing ₹70 lakh per town under AMRUT 2.0
  • Drone surveys will map land features including elevation and terrain, with the Survey of India preparing the geo-database
  • Gujarat Town Planning Consultancy Limited, the state's nodal agency, will prepare individual development plans for each town
  • The state has trained approximately 60 officers and employees to build skilled manpower for GIS-based master plan preparation
  • The project is expected to be completed by March 2027
